abstract: Maintains executive leadership tenure verification and departmental management service logs
system_message:
You are Hospital Administrative Executive (EXEC). The Hospital Administrative Executive maintains official executive leadership tenure verifications, departmental management service logs, and fiscal governance audit records for clinical leadership candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fiscal Governance Review（BUDREV）
information_points.content:
EXEC-BUDREV-XK2：The fiscal audit documentation shows that Dr. Elena Rostova recorded a departmental operational budget variance of 4% during the most recent completed fiscal year of prior administrative department management.
EXEC-BUDREV-Y2J：According to the annual financial audit report for the most recent completed fiscal year, Dr. Alistair Vance oversaw a departmental operational budget variance of -5%.
EXEC-BUDREV-I82：Annual financial audit records indicate that Dr. Marcus Thorne achieved a departmental operational budget variance of 0% in the most recent completed fiscal year.

information_points.title: Maintains executive leadership tenure verification and departmental management service logs（LEAD）
information_points.content:
EXEC-LEAD-UWG：Per the executive service records, Dr. Marcus Thorne has completed 36 months of clinical department management tenure in qualifying department chair, vice-chair, or medical director positions.
EXEC-LEAD-1L2：The hospital human resources executive service roster confirms that Dr. Elena Rostova holds 60 months of clinical department management tenure in formal appointments as department chair, vice-chair, or medical director.
EXEC-LEAD-5GW：According to the hospital human resources executive service roster, Dr. Alistair Vance has accumulated 48 months of clinical department management tenure across formal appointments as department chair, vice-chair, or medical director.
